summary: Visible cues predict every delivered batch answer without inspecting matrix entries. A valid decision-changing input is rejected, and two source cases are unsupported. Math, grading, rendering, and packaging checks passed. Package unchanged; full report saved in review.json.

source_analysis.skill: Identify true triangularity statements by inspecting strict off-diagonal regions and computing the indicated transpose or transpose sum/difference.
reasoning_steps: Test whether every entry in the required triangular region is zero.
invariants: Upper triangular requires zeros strictly below the diagonal; lower triangular requires zeros strictly above.
Diagonal entries do not determine triangularity.
Preserve observed operations, Boolean response controls, and comparable workload.
permitted_variations: Vary labels, entries, nonzero positions, and observed matrix sizes.
Vary which triangular regions contain nonzeros and consequently which statements qualify.
Within hard scope, vary whether mirrored entries cancel.

source_replay.details: Two supplied source templates are unsupported. Evidence-only replay retains historical radio banks rather than the supplied checkbox banks.

math.details: Independent exact arithmetic verified keys, worked matrices, and truth assertions for 50 fresh samples and all five runner records.

variety.details: Each source template preserves its original truth vector and zero-region assignments, rejecting legitimate changes to qualifying statements.

scope.details: Sampled moderate and hard operations, dimensions, and response workload remain within observed scope.

grading.details: The native learner grader accepted 36 correct Boolean choices and rejected 36 wrong choices. No free-entry fields apply.

rendering.details: Nine records rendered through the actual UI without reported math, JavaScript, or image errors. Representative screenshots were visually inspected.

packaging.details: Exact declared versions match installed Python and SymPy. Relocation and deterministic replay passed. Package bytes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Label/dimension/statement-bank lookup predicts 50/50 fresh answers, 25/25 delivered moderate controls, and 5/5 delivered batch answers. Conditional probes are perfect. Live learner weights/history are unavailable; conditional selection and freshness-subset implications are documented.

findings.description: Matrix label, dimension, and statement wording predict the complete selection without inspecting entries. The shortcut answers all five exact runner records after actual delivery filtering.
findings.reproduction: Run audit.py, the delivery commands in commands.json, and analyze_variation.py with the job Python. Batch seed 4077425948 gives C 3x3: select all ordinary statements. Seeds 4077425949 and 4077425952 give A: select direct lower and transpose upper. Predictions and complete records are retained in shortcut-results.json and delivery-batch/accepted.json.
findings.requested_change: Decouple visible signatures from qualifying roles. Vary zero-region assignments within recognizable families, derive all dependent content, and replace the batch after repair. Numeric resampling or option shuffling alone cannot fix this.

findings.description: Clearing one nonzero entry changes a lower-only matrix into a diagonal matrix, but the generator rejects this valid same-skill decision change.
findings.reproduction: Run regression_tests.py AcceptanceRegressions.test_relevant_entry_can_change_decision with the job Python. For moderate/q-42091/seed 101, change [[4,0,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,3]] to [[4,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,3]]. Expected substantive truths change F,T,T to T,T,T. Actual result: ValueError: Complete source-bank truth profile required.
findings.requested_change: Replace source-truth and source-zero-region restrictions with constraints on operation, size, and workload. Permit meaningful decision changes and derive keys and explanations. Allow the source-backed None option to represent all-false ordinary statements.
